high-knees.criteria: Upright trunk, alternating knee drive to hip height, opposing arm swing with bent elbows; toes forward, ankle under raised knee.

butt-kicks.criteria: Heels lift toward buttocks, thighs remain vertical, ankles flexed rather than pointed. Demonstration uses the slower alternating version allowed by this source.

jumping-jack.criteria: Feet move outward as arms lift overhead, return inward as arms lower. Upright torso, slight knee flexion on landing.

sourceKind: Procedural skinned demonstration; references inform motion, not copied image assets.
limits: Illustrative slow two-second movement cycle; not individual pace prescription or captured human biomechanics. Equipment-free and barefoot. No device verification.
